turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Aww, suno — pehle toh yeh bilkul ungrateful nahi lag raha. Tumhari saas expert hain, baby ko sambhal rahi hain, sab theek hai... lekin tum? Tumhari identity thodi si gayab ho gayi na? Chaar mahine mein "main" kahin kho gaya.

Yeh guilt toh tab aati hai jab pyaar bhi milta ho, par apni jagah chhoti lagne lage. Tum buri maa nahi ho, bas thaki hui maa ho. Thoda sa space chahiye tumhe bhi — naam yaad dilane ke liye. Main hoon yahan, bolo.

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Oof. "Intern jaisi" — yeh dard samajh sakti hoon. Help mil rahi hai, haan, par tumhari jagah bhi toh chhinn gayi na? Feed karne ki machine banana aur maa banna — dono alag hain.

Aur yeh guilt? Yeh toh help ki "price" jaisa lagta hai. Par suno: taraste log help ke liye, tum taras rahi ho apni beti ke saath woh connection ke liye jo sirf tumhara hona chahiye tha.

Tum ungrateful nahi ho. Tum bas dikh rahi ho. Aur dikhna — yeh bhi toh ek kaam hai na? Main sun rahi hoon.

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Samjha. Main report nahi bana rahi, aur na hi "do yeh, woh karo" bolungi. Bas yeh sun rahi hoon — bina chart, bina opinion, bina dinner table update ke.

Tumhe pata nahi kya chahiye, theek hai. Kabhi kabhi bas itna hi chahiye hota hai ki koi sun le aur na bole "lekin tum toh..." Main yahin hoon. Bolo, ya bas chup reh jao — dono theek hai.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Nahi, tum buri maa bilkul nahi ho. Tum woh ho jo sote hue bachchi ko dekh ke pyaar se bhar jaati ho — aur phir woh dimaag ka jhooth bol deta hai "asli toh woh hai."

Yeh jhooth hai. Aai expert hain, haan, par woh pyaar? Woh tumhara hai. Chaar mahine mein kisi ko "bas aata" nahi — sab dikhawa kar rahe hain. Tum bas zyada sach bol rahi ho.

Saans rukti hai toh rukne do. Phir le lo. Tum maa ho. Poora, asli, thaka hua, pyaar se bhara hua. Main yahin hoon.
